visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a pink short-sleeved button-up shirt, smiles excitedly while holding a large Cinnamoroll-themed box in a bedroom with white shelves and plush toys. (2) She unboxes the item, revealing plastic trays; the shot cuts to her hands pulling out light blue plastic components of a toy house. (3) In a medium shot, she assembles the house frame, showing a strained facial expression and baring her teeth as she forces the plastic pieces together. (4) The camera provides a close-up of the house interior as her hand slides a printed decorative card into a slot on the back wall. (5) A series of close-up insert shots showcase miniature accessories: a pink and white stroller, a white crib, a small yellow basket with a pink bow, a tiny pink bell, and a small white Cinnamoroll figure in a blue diaper. (6) The video concludes with a static shot of the fully assembled and decorated toy house with various text overlays appearing in the center.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) An energetic female narrator speaks with high-pitched excitement over an upbeat, bright electronic BGM. (2) A sharp, crinkling plastic rustle occurs as the packaging is manipulated. (3) The speaker emits a brief vocal grunt of effort, followed immediately by a distinct mechanical plastic click as the toy house parts snap together. (4) A second mechanical click is heard. (5) A dull, percussive clatter sounds as plastic components fall onto a hard wooden table. (6) The narrator exclaims "Kawaii" in a melodic, rising intonation, accompanied by a bright bubble-pop sound effect. (7) High-density speech follows as various miniature items are introduced, punctuated by rhythmic synth pulses from the BGM. (8) The audio concludes with a cheerful synthesized jingle and a final bell chime stinger.
